name: Erase text
description: Removes text from an image using one sidebar tab with selectable Hybrid pipeline, TMIM, or ViT Eraser methods. Shared detection and scope controls remain stable while method-specific controls appear only when relevant.

fields.name: method
fields.description: Selects the text-removal strategy used by this tab. Hybrid pipeline combines monotonic-background fill with TMIM reconstruction and is the validated default. TMIM runs direct mask-aware reconstruction without hybrid prefill. ViT Eraser runs the alternate vision-transformer model.

options.name: Hybrid pipeline
options.description: Classifies consolidated text regions, prefills qualifying monotonic backgrounds, and reconstructs the remaining masked regions with TMIM.

options.name: TMIM
options.description: Runs direct TMIM reconstruction on the configured text mask without monotonic prefill.

options.name: ViT Eraser
options.description: Runs the alternate vision-transformer erasure model on the configured text mask.

fields.name: detection
fields.description: Selects the detection preset that supplies text regions to erasure. Accurate favors recall so small, faint, or low-contrast words are less likely to remain, at the cost of additional OCR work.

options.name: Accurate
options.description: Uses the high-recall OCR configuration and consolidated text-region processing.

options.name: Fast
options.description: Uses a faster OCR configuration that may miss small or low-contrast text.

options.name: Existing detections
options.description: Reuses text polygons already stored by the Detect text tool without rerunning OCR.

fields.name: apply_scope
fields.description: Limits where the selected erasure method may replace source pixels. OCR regions confines changes to masks derived from detected text, while full image permits broader model reconstruction and can modify pixels outside detected regions.

options.name: OCR regions
options.description: Applies TMIM only within masks derived from detected text regions.

options.name: Full image
options.description: Runs TMIM across the complete image, allowing broader reconstruction but increasing the risk of changing non-text content.

fields.name: background_handling
fields.description: Controls how the pipeline handles text on locally uniform backgrounds. Auto classification estimates background variation per consolidated text region, fills only text-like enclosed pixels in monotonic regions, and sends variable regions to neural reconstruction.

options.name: Auto classify + monotonic fill
options.description: Classifies each consolidated region and prefills text pixels when the surrounding background is locally monotonic before TMIM runs.

options.name: TMIM only
options.description: Skips monotonic prefill and sends all detected text regions directly to TMIM.

options.name: Monotonic fill only
options.description: Uses estimated background-color fill for qualifying regions and does not run TMIM.

fields.name: mask_source
fields.description: Chooses the geometry used to identify pixels that the selected model should reconstruct. OCR plus paragraph uses detected text and consolidation logic so neighboring words can be treated as a coherent region.

options.name: OCR + paragraph
options.description: Builds the mask from OCR detections after merging compatible neighboring words and lines into text regions.

options.name: OCR polygons
options.description: Uses the OCR polygons directly without paragraph-level consolidation.

options.name: Manual mask
options.description: Uses the mask painted or selected by the user.

fields.name: mask_expansion_px
fields.description: Expands the mask outward by this many pixels before reconstruction so antialiased glyph edges and nearby text smears are included. Larger values remove more residual text but can consume surrounding details.

fields.name: preview_quality
fields.description: Balances ViT Eraser preview latency against reconstruction detail. Fast uses reduced inference settings for mask iteration; Detailed uses the full configured resolution and inference budget.

options.name: Fast
options.description: Produces a lower-cost ViT Eraser preview for rapid mask adjustment.

options.name: Detailed
options.description: Uses the higher-quality ViT Eraser inference configuration for final evaluation.

action.name: Run text erasure
action.description: Runs the selected erasure method with the configured detection, mask, scope, and method-specific settings, then creates a non-destructive output version for comparison or acceptance.
